Here’s a classic, well‑balanced list of ingredients you’ll need to make a hearty, traditional lasagna. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) | Notes |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|-------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Dry lasagna noodles (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets | If using regular noodles, pre‑cook them until al dente, then drain and lay flat. |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) | Brown and season with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs. |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium | Adds sweetness and depth. |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 3–4 | Adjust to taste. |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) | For a richer sauce, use a combination of crushed and whole‑tomato sauce. |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp | Concentrates flavor. |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup | Adds acidity and complexity. |
| | Fresh basil, chopped | ¼ cup | Or 1 Tbsp dried basil. |
| | Oregano, dried | 1 tsp | |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste | |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp | For sautéing. |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) | |
| | Egg | 1 large | Helps bind the mixture. |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated | ½ cup | Adds sharpness. |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp | Optional, for freshness. |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste | |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella | 4 cups (about 400 g) | Use part‑mozzarella for meltiness, part part‑low‑fat for a lighter version. |
| **Parmesan topping** | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup | Sprinkle on top for a golden crust. |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach, sautéed | 2 cups | Adds color and nutrition. |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup | Adds umami. |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup | For extra crunch. |
| | Ricotta‑spinach blend | 1 cup | Mix ricotta with sautéed spinach for a green layer. |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if not no‑boil) until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment or lightly oiled tray.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: Sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat, cook until browned. Stir in tomatoes, paste, wine, herbs, salt, pepper; simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta mixture**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, parsley, salt, pepper in a bowl.
4. **Assemble**: Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and optional extras in a 9×13 pan. Repeat layers, finishing with sauce and a generous sprinkle of mozzarella + Parmesan on top.
5. **Bake**: Cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 15–20 min until bubbly and golden.
6. **Rest**: Let stand 10–15 min before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
